controls.parity_recompute_limit: Waveform samples are not archived; trimmed numerical equality is an instrumented runtime assertion. Repeated whole-grid and trimmed hashes are independently checked.
controls.held_stale_rejection_scope: Runtime assertions reject held results after cancel. Event history distinguishes current-generation held chunks from already stale chunks. No direct GPU-submission timestamp or saved sample arrays.

audio.quantile_scope: Probe-reported histogram upper bounds; raw histogram counts are not archived.
audio.measurement_scope: Callback execution and PipeWire-reported driver-position clock timing; not measured end-to-end audio latency, per-stream xrun recovery or a complete graph xrun count.

UI.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications; not physical presentation latency

coverage_gate.minute_bin_scope: Complete 60-second UI-observation bins overlapping the workload; partial final UI bins are excluded

progress.exposure_scope: Sampled heartbeat exposure; spans end at recovery or workload stop, or remain open during the run

coverage_gate.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications and initialized heartbeat with a 30-second unexposed budget; not physical presentation latency

UI.exposure_observation_scope: Only transition pulses are streamed; total false-pulse observations and heartbeat maxima remain instrumented report fields. Open spans include workload end.
UI.minute_bin_scope: Complete60-second UI-observation bins overlapping workload; partial final bin excluded. Notifications are not physical presentation timing.

trace_checks.clock_ticks_scope: SC_CLK_TCK from analysis host; CPU conversion requires matching collection-host clock tick rate
trace_checks.sampling_scope: Successful process/system snapshots; requested interval is recorded separately. Capture cost excludes trace write; gaps include work, requested sleep and scheduling. Counter deltas require stable identities; sched_schedstats=0 limits interpretation. CPU first-to-last excludes process work before first sample. FD read errors do not identify a cause.

interpretation: Global observed p99 alone does not show absence of rare target misses.
Process-alive polling is not proof of continuous UI rendering.
FrameSwapped notifications do not measure physical presentation latency.

resources.scope: Each process separate; native trace independently reaggregated, supervisor summary only. No RSS+DRM/client-peak sums.

policy_qualification.scope: Per-sample observations, not atomic or continuous policy history. Missing values/deviations are explicitly reported, never zero-filled. Balanced runner is expected to set/restore profile without a hold.

before.comparison: Full3600s balanced workload after successful120s preflight and real interrupted-wrapper cleanup check. Same frozen native/model/UI/audio/worker/soak asperformance reference; recorded starting temperatures and memory differ.

monitor.scope: No hold expected for balanced trial; any nonempty or missing hold/profile field requires qualification.

lifecycle.scope: Wrapper before/during/before_restore/after snapshots; full native trace and external monitor supply separate run observations.

source_immutability_scope: In-run pins plus optional before/current file comparisons; missing or changed current files are reported. Snapshots cannot prove no byte-for-byte-reverted intermediate mutation.

reference_timing.percentile_method: nearest rank; consecutive windows are not independent tail samples

reference_comparison.scope: Sequential finite trials on same fixture; does not establish causality or a production tail bound.

continuous_comparison.scope: The observed p99 can decrease while miss fraction and maximum increase. Neither result passing the target, nor causation, is implied.

annotations.description: Synthetic bass, kick, noise hats, changing tones and asymmetric clicks.

acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
acceptance.scope: synthetic saturated delivery, animated UI and independent silent audio; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim

limitations: Nearest-rank percentiles of consecutive correlated windows do not bound future tail latency.
Control replacement latency includes preroll; supervisor started+150ms is not a GPU-submission timestamp.
No archived waveform arrays or raw callback histogram: exact/numeric parity and callback quantile bounds are instrumented reports, with repeated hashes independently checked.
GUI notifications and heartbeat metadata do not measure physical presentation.
Check optional system-read/fdinfo/sample/trace errors separately; missing counters are not zero.
sched_schedstats=0 limits interpretation of runqueue counters; counter deltas need stable task/PID identities.
Source-path hashes can be compared only where the original files still exist; pin identity remains archived.

finding.scope: No M1 advancement is implied by this saved-evidence audit.
